name: jira-time-logger
description: A modern CLI tool to log time to Jira from various time-tracking sources

scripts.build: pnpm --filter @jira-logger/config build && pnpm --filter @jira-logger/parsers build && pnpm --filter @jira-logger/jira-api build && pnpm --filter @jira-logger/core build && pnpm --filter @jira-logger/cli build
scripts.typecheck: pnpm build && pnpm --filter @jira-logger/config typecheck && pnpm --filter @jira-logger/parsers typecheck && pnpm --filter @jira-logger/jira-api typecheck && pnpm --filter @jira-logger/core typecheck && pnpm --filter @jira-logger/cli typecheck
